scope: N1 snapshot of all PDF pages and all workbook sheets, text labels/units, occupied cells/types/percent formats, page image counts. Snapshot changes require review; expected profiles are never learned from a changed live document.
limits: N1 is layout drift detection, not N2 numeric reconciliation or N3 equivalence. All original PDF labels and workbook occupied cells are scanned; numeric literals/years are removed from labels and checked by independent N2 oracles. Raster-only data remain unverified. Routine source changes in month labels/occupied cells may also require reviewing a new snapshot. Live mode covers three latest documents only, not all historical catalog variants.
